snippet.title: Interdimensional Vending Machine | Final Steam Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
In the Interdimensional Vending Machine, you play as an unnamed, starving homeless girl wandering the cold streets of a distorted, unsettling city. Desperate and hungry after dumpster diving, she stumbles upon a mysterious, glitching vending machine (heavily inspired by the SCP Foundation's SCP-261).

The machine accepts Japanese Yen, so the girl must sit on the streets and beg strangers for change. She uses these coins to buy items from the machine to stave off hunger and thirst. However, the machine dispenses bizarre, otherworldly food and drinks that defy logic and biology—such as centipede noodles, anomalous liquids, or even a "Diet Ghost." 

Every meal is a gamble. What the girl consumes physically alters her body and the world around her. If she isn't careful, the food can mutate her into grotesque or bizarre forms.
